description: This file defines an abstract base class `StorageAdapter` that provides an interface for various storage backends in a predictive maintenance system. It specifies methods for initializing storage, managing assets, telemetry data, and alerts, allowing for flexible backend implementations such as Postgres, TimescaleDB, or DynamoDB.

classes.name: StorageAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for storage backends, including methods for initialization, data management (assets, telemetry), and alert handling.

methods.name: None init(self)
methods.description: Initialize the storage backend, such as creating tables or running migrations.

methods.name: list[Asset] seed_sample_assets(self)
methods.description: Ensure a small set of sample assets exists and return them.

methods.name: Asset create_asset(self, asset_id: str, name: str, type: str)
methods.description: Create and return a new asset with specified ID, name, and type.

methods.name: Asset|None get_asset(self, asset_id: str)
methods.description: Fetch a single asset by its ID, or return None if not found.

methods.name: datetime|None get_latest_telemetry_timestamp(self, asset_id: str)
methods.description: Return the most recent telemetry timestamp for a given asset.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] query_telemetry_range( self, asset_id: str, start: datetime, end: datetime, )
methods.description: Query telemetry records for an asset within a specified time range, ordered by timestamp.

methods.name: int insert_telemetry(self, record: TelemetryRecord)
methods.description: Insert a telemetry record and return its database ID.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] list_telemetry( self, asset_id: str, start: datetime | None = None, end: datetime | None = None, limit: int = 500, )
methods.description: List telemetry records for an asset with optional time filters and limit.

methods.name: Alert create_alert(self, asset_id: str, severity: AlertSeverity, message: str)
methods.description: Create and return an alert for a specific asset with severity and message.

methods.name: tuple[list[Alert],int] list_alerts_filtered(self, flt: AlertFilter)
methods.description: List alerts based on specified filters, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: tuple[list[Alert],list[str]] ack_alerts( self, alert_ids: list[str], acked_by: str | None, ack_comment: str | None, )
methods.description: Acknowledge one or more alerts by IDs, returning updated alerts and IDs not found.

methods.name: list[Alert] list_alerts(self, asset_id: str | None = None, limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Legacy method to list alerts optionally filtered by asset ID, without total count.

methods.name: Alert|None ack_alert(self, alert_id: str, acked_by: str, ack_comment: str | None)
methods.description: Legacy method to acknowledge a single alert by ID.
